messages:
maggie: Heads-up for roadmap doc: need firm stance on "public list floor" vs allowed discounts. Board asked for guidance. Decision today?

emily: Can we call it a "list floor" (minimum advertised price) for Hosted, and allow discounts only via signed amendment for Dedicated/Private? Easier for finance.

raj: Agree on list floor. Also propose an exceptions table: reason, approver, max discount %, expiry. Keeps things auditable.

tom: Operational requirement: billing must track fields: list_price, effective_price, discount_reason, approval_ticket. Also console view for AEs.

legal-bot: Legal: signed amendment + approval ticket is a must for exceptions. Recommend 120 days notice for any upcoming public price increases; grandfather existing contracts per their terms.

finance-bot: Finance: list floor simplifies ARR modeling. If we allow % caps on discounts, please add a reporting column for margin impact per deal.

maggie: Proposal to finalize: 1) Public list floor for Hosted & public add-ons. 2) Discounts allowed only for Dedicated/Private with signed amendment + approval ticket. 3) Exceptions recorded using table Raj proposed (fields + approver + expiry). 4) 120d notice for public price increases; grandfather per contract. 5) Billing/Console changes tracked in ticket.

emily: Sounds good. One UX ask: make a tenant-level banner when effective_price != list_price so customers see it.

raj: I'll prototype the exceptions table format and attach sample CSV.

tom: I'll open infra ticket for billing + console fields.

maggie: Owners: emily (pricing policy doc), raj (exceptions table), tom (billing + console), legal-bot (amendment template), finance-bot (reporting column). I'll ship the roadmap blurb after lunch unless objections.

emily: No objections. :+1:

legal-bot: No objections from legal side.
